question: Is deterministic mixed real/mock proof sufficient for this timing race, or must the contributor demonstrate a real installed binding and routed-channel abort?
rationale: The race is deterministic in the focused harness, but the external-PR proof policy normally requires after-fix behavior from a real setup and the central route and binding dependencies remain mocked.

options.title: Require live binding proof
options.body: Hold merge until a real installed plugin binding and routed channel show that a mid-route abort suppresses fallback delivery.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: Accept the deterministic runtime harness as the strongest practical evidence for this narrow timing race and apply a maintainer proof override.

recommendation.title: Require live binding proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until a real installed plugin binding and routed channel show that a mid-route abort suppresses fallback delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the interacting fast-abort route and response-prefix behavior on current main.
